caption: A long, slender dark organism hangs diagonally from the upper right toward the centre of a deep blue water column, its body lined with two parallel rows of tiny white specks and ending in a rounded bell with a side flap. The bell drifts downward through the first part of the view, then remains lower while the overall angle of the body stays nearly constant. A soft glow concentrated behind the creature keeps its silhouette sharp against the darkening edges. Around the middle of the view a green bioluminescent pulse ignites near the head and travels steadily up the body, fading as it reaches the upper section. Small cyan and green streaks and blurry bokeh dots stream continuously past, shifting relative to the organism and suggesting slow motion between subject, particles and viewpoint. The creature shows no visible directed swim across the scene.
